parity_summary.notifications: Native Tauri notification delivery is behind the shared shell command, reuses the existing attention-policy fields and redaction semantics, checks permission state, requests at most once per process after a prompt state, and carries only validated navigation metadata. Mobile registers only the Open ForgeLink action; it grants no decision authority.
parity_summary.deep_links: The forgelink://open/<surface>/<local-id> grammar is strict, bounded, and fail-closed. Startup uses get_current, running-app events use on_open_url, and malformed/query-bearing/path-traversal links never reach the renderer.
parity_summary.single_instance: Tauri registers single-instance before deep-link handling. The second-instance callback activates the existing main window; the deep-link plugin forwards the URL event instead of starting a competing local backend.
parity_summary.navigation: The shared renderer receives one onNavigationIntent contract, restores only five allow-listed top-level surfaces from local storage, and treats IDs as bounded selection hints. Deep-link and notification paths do not call approve, deny, send, call, or provider commands.
parity_summary.external_navigation: Tauri and Electron open only bounded credential-free HTTPS URLs through their native openers; ForgeLink URLs and credential-bearing URLs are rejected.
parity_summary.platform_limits: Windows installed-app toast identity, packaged Windows installation, and packaged Android/iOS notification/deep-link smoke remain explicit TPR-007/008 gates. Linux/macOS packaging and signing posture remain TPR-008 gates.
